headline: World Bank Flags Unpaid NIN Agents as 59 Million Nigerians Lack Identification
summary: The World Bank reported that enrollment agents contracted by Nigeria's National Identity Management Commission have been unpaid since January 2026, leaving 59 million citizens unenrolled.
why: National identification registration is required for formal banking, telecommunications access, and public administration in Nigeria.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Unpaid registration agents slow digital identity rollout, delaying formal economic and financial inclusion.
